neighborhoods.name: Old Town
neighborhoods.notes: conservation area with historic timber-frame and period locks

property_mix.era: mixed Victorian and interwar with modern infill
property_mix.notable: Chiltern market town with strong heritage stock; many original sash windows and period hardware

locksmith_relevant: Old Town's listed properties often retain period locks requiring specialist knowledge and heritage-compliant repairs.
High proportion of Victorian terraces means frequent sash-window lock and traditional bolt servicing work.
Commuter-belt location creates demand for emergency callouts from London workers with older residential stock.
